name: Helen, tennis section
text: Lovely for the bar takings. Come down at eleven on a Tuesday though. The padel courts are empty and every tennis court is full. Padel is a four-hours-a-day sport. Tennis is all day and all evening, and it always has been.

name: Anonymous
text: I live behind a padel club. It's not the sport I mind, it's the noise. Every evening, 6 till 10, like someone being locked out of a conservatory. Please don't build any more next to houses.

author: terry
text: Fine. Have your padel. But the minute anyone puts "convert a tennis court" on an agenda, I'm resigning. Again.

author: jake
text: The clubs where this works seem to treat it as both, not either. Tennis keeps its mornings and afternoons, padel gets its evenings, and nobody digs anything up. We built [Rallio](https://rallio.io/for-clubs/) so one club can run tennis and padel sessions side by side, each with its own sign-ups, which takes a lot of the heat out of the booking sheet.
